What the checks found:

- In beat "swap", zone "backend"'s label is covered by the label of edge "exchange" by 11.9 px.
- In beat "token", zone "backend"'s label is covered by the label of edge "exchange" by 11.9 px.
- In beat "session", the label of edge "callback" and badge on "app" overlap by 6.5 px.
- In beat "fetch", the label of edge "fetch" and badge on "app" overlap by 26.2 px.
- In beat "done", the label of edge "fetch" and badge on "app" overlap by 26.2 px.

id.description: A node, edge or zone id, as it is.

labels.description: Shorter labels, by id; none when the scenes alone fix it.

from.description: For move and copy: where from.

value.description: For add, replace and test: the value as JSON text, such as "\"Google\"" or "{\"id\": \"retry\"}".

storyboardPatch.description: A JSON Patch on storyboard.json moving nodes or beats to another scene or a new one; empty when the labels alone fix it.

summary.description: What the repair changes, in a sentence.

reply.text: {"labels":[{"id":"exchange","label":"code + secret"},{"id":"callback","label":"send code"},{"id":"fetch","label":"GET /photos"}],"storyboardPatch":[],"summary":"Shortened the edge labels for exchange, callback and fetch so they no longer cover the backend zone label or the badge on the app node; the storyboard is unchanged."}
